# CoreLink Do Not Track (DNT) Policy
# RFC 5785 well-known resource; format per EFF DNT Policy v1.0.
#
# This file is served at https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/.well-known/dnt-policy.txt
# Last updated: 2026-05-15
# Canonical: https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/.well-known/dnt-policy.txt

CoreLink ("we") commits to the following behaviour for any HTTP request
where the user agent sends the `DNT: 1` header (RFC 6797 §5, W3C TPE).

## 1. Honoring DNT

When `DNT: 1` is present on any request to:

  - the CoreLink product hosts under humangr.com: corelink-api,
    corelink-app, corelink-docs, corelink-signup, and corelink-admin
    (each `.humangr.com`)

we will not:

  - Set, read, or augment any cross-site tracking cookie.
  - Forward request metadata to any third-party analytics, advertising,
    or attribution vendor.
  - Build, refine, or sell behavioural profiles of the user.
  - Share IP-address-derived geolocation with any third party for
    advertising or attribution purposes.

## 2. What we still do, regardless of DNT

Some processing is strictly necessary to serve the request safely. With or
without `DNT: 1`, we may:

  - Keep short-lived (≤ 30 day) request logs for security, abuse
    prevention, and operational debugging.
  - Apply rate limiting and DDoS protection (Cloudflare-managed).
  - Set strictly-necessary first-party session cookies (auth, CSRF,
    consent state) — these are not used for tracking.
  - Process API authentication tokens and audit-log writes — operating
    the service requires this.

## 3. Sub-processors and DNT

Where a vendor in our [public sub-processor list](https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/trust/subprocessors)
honours DNT independently (e.g., Cloudflare's privacy posture), the DNT
signal is propagated unmodified. Where a vendor does not honour DNT, we
do not enable behavioural-tracking features in that vendor's product,
regardless of the DNT signal.

## 4. Retention

  - Request logs subject to DNT-conformant handling: ≤ 30 days.
  - Aggregate, non-identifying counts: up to 13 months (operational
    capacity planning).
  - Audit-chain events (security / compliance): 7 years, per LGPD /
    SOC 2 retention requirements; these are tenant-scoped, not user-
    behaviour records.

## 5. Reporting non-conformance

If you observe a violation of this policy:

  Email:  security@humangr.com
  Subject prefix: [DNT]
  Trust Center: https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/trust

We will acknowledge within 5 business days and remediate any confirmed
violation within 30 days.

## 6. Updates

Material changes to this policy will be announced on the status page and
listed under "Sub-processor and policy changes" on the Trust Center, with
at least 30 days' advance notice.
